items.title: Jensen Huang Is a White House Scandal
items.content_text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following revelations of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, triggering market instability. President Donald Trump has intervened, with Attorney General Todd Blanche confirming that Huang is not currently a target of DOJ investigations, aimed at stabilizing the AI supply chain and capital market sentiment.

items.title: OpenAI Engineer Secretly Recorded Dozens of Meetings, Prosecutors Say
items.content_text: Federal prosecutors disclosed in court filings that former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan used OpenAI’s Codex AI tool to configure recording devices, capturing dozens of confidential meetings, including sensitive discussions with a foreign government. While data exfiltration remains under investigation, the act constitutes a significant breach of trade secrets and attorney-client privilege.

items.title: OpenAI Staffer Likely Captured Secrets on Hidden Bug, US Says
items.content_text: Former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting recording devices in executive conference rooms, capturing hundreds of audio files including sovereign government briefings and confidential customer data. Prosecutors allege he utilized OpenAI’s internal tool, Codex, to configure the devices for voice-activated recording and automated exfiltration, with judicial proceedings now underway.

items.title: France, U.S. Suspect Iran Was Behind Cyberattack on European Fridges
items.content_text: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot officially attributed the cyberattack on over 700 European supermarket refrigeration controllers to Iran's 'SHAHID KAVEH' cyber unit during a G7 meeting. The attack, occurring between October 11-12, caused widespread equipment failures, fires, and tens of millions of euros in food losses, marking a transition from espionage to physical infrastructure sabotage.

items.title: Australian IoT Startup Aims to Help Bridge the Gap Between AI and the Real World
items.content_text: Australian satellite IoT provider Myriota has secured approximately $40 million in the first close of its Series C funding round to scale its proprietary satellite constellation and expand its workforce. The company specializes in low-power, wide-area connectivity for industrial data collection in remote environments.

items.title: HPE Gives Outlook That Falls Short of Optimistic Estimates
items.content_text: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $14.5 billion, a 50% year-over-year increase, beating analyst estimates of $14.3 billion. Despite the strong headline figures, the company's Q1 revenue guidance fell short of the most optimistic analyst expectations, triggering a 6%+ decline in after-hours trading due to concerns over the sustainability of high-growth AI server demand.

items.content_text: OpenAI has officially rolled out the GPT-6.2 model to Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Business users. This iteration delivers significant enhancements in multimodal understanding and instruction following, outperforming its predecessor in expert-level reasoning tasks while demonstrating marked improvements in safety policy compliance, particularly regarding youth protection.

items.title: Trump Saw Nvidia's Huang as Protector of Open-Weight AI Models, Sources Say
items.content_text: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, just 11 days after his resignation amid scandal and foreign intelligence investigation. U.S. leadership intervened to secure his return, viewing him as the indispensable protector of the American open-weight AI ecosystem and a critical instrument for maintaining technical leverage against China.

items.title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
items.content_text: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki revealed the log-perplexity scores for models from GPT-3.5 to GPT-6 and beyond, illustrating how capabilities emerge as metrics improve. This initiative aims to establish a common industry performance standard to encourage rivals to coordinate development pacing at critical safety thresholds.
